Message.En: A Calamity at the Cathedral Ruins

Based on the story of White Guard Knight Gordon,
investigate the cause of the supernatural
phenomena hidden within the abandoned church.
Message.Jp:
白衛騎士団員ゴートンの話をもとに
廃教会に潜む怪異の原因を探る

Message.En:
We have received a report from <NAME AREA>
that someone is looking for a collaborator.
Message.Jp:
協力者を求める者がいるとの報告が
<NAME AREA>から届いている

Message.En:
On the outskirts of the street,
there's a crumbling castle wall, right? 
It seems that a member of the Knights' Order
has been standing there with a pensive look for a while. 
Recently, they've been conducting preliminary
investigations of suspicious places
and patrolling the houses in the area. 
I wonder if something has happened.
Message.Jp:
街道のはずれに、崩れかけた城壁があるでしょう？
そのあたりで騎士団の団員が、物思いの顔で
しばらく留まっていたらしいです
最近は不審な場所の事前調査とか、民家周辺の
巡回警備をやってるらしいのですが
何か問題でも起こったんでしょうかね
不死者の集団を排除する
